traits.description: Slows down fussing over details that don't really matter.
Drops a case now and then — minor damage adds up over time.
Misplaces tools and forgets the occasional assigned task.
Rushes and cuts corners whenever the clock is ticking.
Resists new methods even when they're clearly better.
Chats with coworkers instead of moving the freight.
Loses focus on long, repetitive picking runs.
Takes a while to get up to speed at the top of each shift.
Leaves a messy area that slows the whole crew down.
Skips checks, certain they couldn't have made a mistake.
Mind wanders off; needs a nudge to stay on task.
Grumpy and sluggish whenever stuck on the early shift.
Skips steps to finish faster, risking costly errors.
Snaps at coworkers the moment things go sideways.
Spreads rumors that can quietly sink team morale.
Strolls in after the whistle and holds up the line.
The breakroom fridge simply isn't safe around them.
Cranks up the noise and distracts the whole aisle.
A chronic phone-checker, easily pulled off task.
Digs in hard against absolutely any kind of change.
